Minimum: Intel 6th Generation or newer CPU, or AMD Ryzen 1000 Series or newer CPU. Advanced Vector Extensions 2 (AVX2) support required. Note: It is not possible to install the 24.x or later versions on Intel 3rd Generation of processors or older (as well as older AMD processors).

page_title: Professional video editing software | Adobe Premiere
heading: Premiere for teams
text:
Premiere for teams
Video editing that's always a cut above.

Edit and trim video. Add effects, mix audio, and animate titles. Supercharge your workflow with AI. Create complex masks in a snap with Object Mask in Premiere (beta). And edit anywhere with the new iPhone app.

Premiere for teams includes admin tools, dedicated 24x7 support, team libraries, and more.

Not a business? Explore options for individuals or students and teachers.

Build your brand and grow your business with Creative Cloud Pro for teams. Create standout content with 20+ world-class apps plus integrated generative AI, collaboration tools, and exclusive business features.

Introducing Color Mode. A new era starts now. Experience a first-of-its-kind color grading system - purpose-built for editors - in Premiere (beta). Shape precisely, explore confidently, and push your look without ever leaving your edit.

Editing. Craft the perfect story. Use industry-standard video editing tools and timesaving AI features to get to the right cut fast. Hone your narrative with three-point editing. Try Text-Based Editing to refine, reorder, and trim clips just like you'd edit a text doc. And quickly search your footage with AI-powered Media Intelligence to identify objects, locations, framing, and other details.

Color. Balance color and set the tone. Get the right look for your video with powerful color correction and grading tools. Drop footage from nearly any camera into your timeline instantly and transform your raw and log footage on import without LUTs. Balance color fast with AI, use professional color wheels and curve controls, and check your results with built-in video scopes.

page_title: Explore Premiere features | Adobe
heading: Premiere
text:
Premiere
Explore Adobe Premiere features.

Learn all about the tools and techniques you can use to edit videos, animate titles, add effects, mix sound, and more.

What's new. Editing. Effects. Title. Color. Audio. Exporting.

Improve your workflow and take your videos to the next level with powerful, timesaving tools and AI features.

Color Mode - a new era starts now. Experience a first-of-its-kind color grading system - purpose-built for editors - in Premiere (beta). Shape, explore, and push your look like never before.

Fast track how you mask with AI. Say hello to Object Mask and goodbye to hours of painful rotoscoping. Just hover over your subject, click, and watch as AI accurately masks and tracks it.

Any shape mask. All the control. Redesigned shape masks now track motion faster across frames with pinpoint accuracy. Perfect for tackling precise color and effects work with ease.

Over 100 next-level effects and transitions. Elevate your edit with all-new transitions, effects, and animations - they're cinematic and GPU-accelerated for real-time playback.

Media Intelligence. A better way to search. Search footage in seconds by describing sound effects, like barking dogs or rain - or by keying in specific dialogue. Quickly locate alt takes and visually similar clips. And censor any unwanted words with a click.

Go from generating to editing, fast. Generate video in Adobe Firefly Boards or on the web app, then send your project-ready clip directly to Premiere on desktop. Generate eye-grabbing visual effects, beautiful b-roll to fill timeline gaps, or anything you can imagine.

Now available from Adobe and YouTube: A dedicated space and exclusive content to create YouTube Shorts - right inside Premiere on iPhone.
